name.ja: BB戦士 LEGENDBB 二代目頑駄無大将軍（白鋼Ｖｅｒ．）
name.en: BB Senshi LEGENDBB Second Generation Gundam udaishōgun (White Steel Ver.)

description.ja: 伝説の白鋼、レジェンドＢＢで、今、甦る！！ ＬＥＧＥＮＤＢＢ 二代目大将軍、幻の‘白鋼Ｖｅｒ．’登場！！
description.en: The legendary white steel, Legend BB, is now revived! ! LEGENDBB Second Great General, Phantom 'White Steel Ver. 'Appearance! !

description.ja: 銀メッキと銀の成形色で、‘白鋼’へとパワーアップを遂げた二代目大将軍を豪華に再現。
description.en: With silver plating and silver molding color, the second generation general who has been powered up to 'white steel' is luxuriously reproduced.

description.ja: ＢＢ戦士ファン必携、あの伝説の姿‘白鋼Ｖｅｒ．’を、レジェンドＢＢシリーズキットで商品化。
description.en: A must-have for BB Senshi fans, that legendary figure 'White Steel Ver. ’ is commercialized with the Legend BB Series Kit.

description.ja: ●　銀メッキ加工＆銀の成形色で‘白鋼’を再現!
description.en: ● Reproduce 'white steel' with silver plating and silver molding color!

description.ja: 角飾り、鎧の一部には、光沢の銀メッキ加工を施行。
description.en: The corner ornaments and parts of the armor are plated with shiny silver.

description.ja: 鎧や日輪剣などには、銀色の成形色を採用し、グロスインジェクション成形で艶感のある仕上がり。
description.en: A silver molding color is used for the armor and ring sword, and gloss injection molding gives it a glossy finish.

description.ja: ●　雷凰頑駄無用の換装鎧一式が付属！
description.en: ● Comes with a set of replacement armor for Raiou Gundam!

description.ja: ●　遊びの幅が広がる多彩なギミックを搭載！
description.en: ● Equipped with a variety of gimmicks that expand the range of play!

description.ja: 武者フォートレス、武者フェニックスに変形可能。
description.en: Can be transformed into Musha Fortress and Musha Phoenix.

description.ja: 軽装形態再現可能。バトルマスク装着可能。ヘッドバスター、大目牙砲は、肩越しへの展開が可能。
description.en: Lightly armored form can be reproduced. Can be equipped with a battle mask. Head buster and large fire cannon can be deployed over the shoulder.

description.ja: ノンスケール組み立て式プラモデル
description.en: Non-Scale Assembly type plastic model

description.ja: 対象年齢：15才以上
